pokemon_scp.name: Bulbasaur
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0001 is to be contained in a reinforced terrarium with automated humidity and light-cycle control. Access is restricted to Level 2 personnel equipped with protective eyewear. Direct physical contact with the dorsal bulb is prohibited. In the event of uncontrolled photonic discharge, terrarium shutters are to be sealed and personnel evacuated until luminosity returns to baseline.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0001 resembles a small quadrupedal reptile with a plant-like growth on its back. The dorsal bulb contains bioluminescent tissue capable of emitting concentrated photonic bursts. These emissions can temporarily blind or disorient exposed subjects and have been observed to fluctuate in intensity based on nearby emotional states.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Generally docile and responsive to calm interaction. SCP-0001 becomes agitated when its bulb is touched or when exposed to sudden loud noises, resulting in rapid, uncontrolled light flares.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0001-A: During routine observation, SCP-0001’s luminosity increased in sync with elevated heart rates of nearby personnel, suggesting a form of empathic photoreception.
Addendum 0001-B: A brief containment lapse occurred when SCP-0001’s flash blinded a guard, allowing it to burrow partially through the terrarium substrate before recontainment.

pokemon_scp.name: Ivysaur
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0002 is to be housed in a bio-containment greenhouse with reinforced root barriers and sub-surface sensor arrays. Weekly nutrient injections are mandatory to prevent uncontrolled root expansion. Any attempt by SCP-0002 to penetrate structural foundations must be met with immediate root severance and localized herbicidal application.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0002 exhibits advanced plant-animal integration, with vine-like appendages capable of precise manipulation. These vines demonstrate tensile strength exceeding human muscle and can interface with mechanical and electrical systems. The dorsal plant structure shows accelerated growth and can anchor SCP-0002 into soil or porous material within minutes.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Displays territorial behavior, attempting to root into any available substrate. SCP-0002 becomes hostile when its vines are restrained, often targeting restraints and nearby equipment.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0002-A: SCP-0002’s vines were observed wrapping around exposed wiring, causing localized power fluctuations and short circuits.
Addendum 0002-B: A partial breach occurred when SCP-0002 rooted into a drainage system, extending its reach beyond the greenhouse perimeter before being neutralized.

pokemon_scp.name: Venusaur
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0003 is to be contained within a hardened botanical dome equipped with atmospheric filtration, spore scrubbers, and remote-operated sedation gas dispensers. No personnel are permitted inside the dome without full hazmat gear and cognitive resistance training. In the event of spore release, the dome is to be sealed and internal atmosphere cycled through emergency scrubbers until spore density returns to safe levels.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0003 is a massive reptilian-plant hybrid capable of generating hallucinogenic spores from its central flower. Inhalation or dermal exposure induces vivid multi-sensory hallucinations, loss of motor control, and temporal disorientation. Spore analysis indicates complex psychoactive compounds that adapt to the subject’s memories and fears.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Typically slow-moving and inert, SCP-0003 becomes violently aggressive when threatened or when its flower is disturbed. During aggression, spore output increases exponentially.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0003-A: A containment drill failed when exposed personnel experienced synchronized hallucinations of non-existent breaches, abandoning their posts.
Addendum 0003-B: Long-term exposure to trace spore levels has been linked to recurring nightmares in staff, even after decontamination.

pokemon_scp.name: Charmander
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0004 is to be contained in a fireproof chamber with continuous thermal monitoring. The tail flame must remain active at all times; any observed dimming triggers immediate medical evaluation. Fire suppression systems are to be configured to avoid direct application to SCP-0004’s tail.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0004 is a small bipedal reptile with a perpetual flame at the tip of its tail. Thermal imaging suggests the flame is linked to SCP-0004’s vital signs, fluctuating with stress and physical exertion. Attempts to extinguish the flame via conventional means have failed, resulting instead in heightened distress and increased ambient temperature.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Generally friendly and curious, SCP-0004 becomes panicked when its tail is threatened, producing uncontrolled fire bursts and attempting to flee.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0004-A: During a routine inspection, a careless gesture toward SCP-0004’s tail resulted in a sudden flare that scorched containment sensors.
Addendum 0004-B: SCP-0004 appears to seek out warm surfaces and has been observed sleeping near heating units when given the opportunity.

pokemon_scp.name: Charmeleon
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0005 is to be contained in a heat-resistant enclosure with reinforced viewing panels. Personnel interacting with SCP-0005 must maintain calm demeanor and avoid sudden movements. In case of elevated aggression, localized cooling systems may be activated to reduce ambient temperature and discourage further escalation.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0005 exhibits heightened aggression compared to SCP-0004 and can superheat its claws to temperatures sufficient to melt steel. Thermal scans show rapid heat buildup in forelimbs prior to attack, suggesting a deliberate weaponization of body heat.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Highly territorial, SCP-0005 reacts violently to perceived intrusions or abrupt gestures. Displays dominance behaviors, including tail lashing and vocalizations, before engaging.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0005-A: SCP-0005 melted through a steel feeding tray during a stress event, necessitating upgraded containment materials.
Addendum 0005-B: Attempts at behavioral conditioning have yielded limited success; SCP-0005 responds only to consistent, non-threatening routines.

pokemon_scp.name: Charizard
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0006 is to be contained in an aerial hangar with reinforced thermal shielding and retractable roof segments for emergency venting. No personnel may approach within 20 meters without full heat-resistant suits. In-flight testing is strictly prohibited outside of controlled simulations. Sedative aerosols are to be kept on standby in case of containment breach.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0006 is a large draconic organism capable of generating plasma-level flames. Recorded temperatures from its breath attacks exceed those of industrial furnaces. SCP-0006 demonstrates problem-solving skills and situational awareness comparable to advanced primates, including recognition of containment weaknesses.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive toward perceived challengers and displays territorial aerial patterns. Prefers high-altitude environments and often attempts to reach elevated vantage points within the hangar.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0006-A: SCP-0006 breached containment by melting a titanium gate after repeated observation of guard patrol routes.
Addendum 0006-B: Post-incident analysis suggests SCP-0006 intentionally targeted structural weak points rather than random escape attempts.

pokemon_scp.name: Squirtle
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0007 is housed in an aquatic enclosure with filtration and moderate current simulation. Interaction is permitted for Level 1 personnel under supervision. Water jets are to be directed away from sensitive equipment.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0007 is a small turtle-like organism capable of projecting high-pressure water jets from its mouth. These jets can chip concrete at close range but are generally used for play and communication. SCP-0007’s shell exhibits resilience beyond typical biological material, resisting blunt force and minor thermal exposure.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Playful and social, SCP-0007 frequently engages in water-based games with staff. Uses water jets to create patterns and glyphs on surfaces.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0007-A: SCP-0007 produced a water glyph resembling the Foundation insignia, raising questions about its visual recognition capabilities.
Addendum 0007-B: Repeated interaction sessions suggest SCP-0007 can distinguish individual staff members and responds differently to each.

pokemon_scp.name: Wartortle
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0008 is contained in a reinforced aquatic tank with energy-dampening barriers. Its tail is to be monitored for anomalous energy buildup via embedded sensors. Sudden spikes in kinetic output require temporary isolation and observation.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0008 displays enhanced hydrokinesis, capable of generating whirlpools and directed water flows within confined spaces. The fur on its tail appears to store kinetic energy, releasing it in bursts that amplify water movement.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: More serious and reserved than SCP-0007. Engages in ritualistic grooming of its tail, particularly before generating large-scale water effects.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0008-A: Tail fur samples exhibit microstructures capable of storing and releasing kinetic energy, similar to biological capacitors.
Addendum 0008-B: A minor containment incident occurred when SCP-0008 generated a whirlpool strong enough to dislodge monitoring equipment.

pokemon_scp.name: Blastoise
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0009 is to be restrained in a reinforced aquatic tank with hydraulic dampeners. Its cannons must be locked in neutral position via mechanical clamps when not in testing scenarios. All live-fire tests require remote operation and armored observation posts.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0009 is a massive turtle organism with dual hydraulic cannons mounted on its shell. These cannons can project water jets with sufficient force to penetrate armored vehicles and reinforced barriers. Internal scans suggest a complex network of pressure chambers and muscular valves controlling output.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Slow-moving under normal conditions but extremely destructive when agitated. Displays defensive posturing before firing, including shell retraction and cannon alignment.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0009-A: SCP-0009 destroyed a Foundation APC during controlled testing, despite reduced output settings.
Addendum 0009-B: Subsequent tests indicate SCP-0009 can modulate pressure with high precision, suggesting deliberate targeting rather than random discharge.

pokemon_scp.name: Caterpie
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0010 is contained in a small terrarium with a steady supply of leaves and climbing structures. No special hazard protocols are required beyond standard handling procedures. Silk production is to be collected and cataloged for research.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0010 is a small larval organism capable of producing silk with tensile strength exceeding Kevlar. The silk adheres strongly to most surfaces and can be woven into complex patterns by SCP-0010. Despite its anomalous material properties, SCP-0010 itself is physically fragile.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Docile and avoids confrontation, preferring to climb vertical surfaces and remain near foliage. Shows curiosity toward new structures placed in its terrarium.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0010-A: SCP-0010’s silk was successfully integrated into prototype containment netting, significantly improving tear resistance.
Addendum 0010-B: Patterns in SCP-0010’s webbing occasionally resemble geometric symbols; significance unknown.
